title: Shared readiness-discovery building blocks
description: Definitions shared by the integration readiness contracts (master plan 9.5, ADR 0037), referenced as urn:alixai:schema:readiness:shared:v1#/$defs/<name>. This file is a definitions library: it constrains nothing on its own. Readiness discovery is advisory, operator-launched and evidence-bound: nothing defined here describes a certification, an authorisation, a permission grant, an approval, a signature or an activation, and nothing may be added that does.

category.title: Requirement category
category.description: What kind of thing a requirement or finding is about. mcp: an MCP server and its tool list. openapi: an OpenAPI or other API description. native_adapter: a native adapter and its declared operations. model_runtime: model and runtime needs and the data that could leave through an external model. deterministic_data: deterministic read, validate, prepare and commit surfaces with typed results. documentation: documentation per capability. conversation_contract: conversation-contract material and terminology. rag_source: RAG source candidates (folders, volumes, document providers). scope_and_auth: identity and scope signals (tenants, workspaces, roles, principals). permissions: the permission model. deployment: deployment facts (package files and signatures, compose files, migrations, ports, inspection). A value outside this list is rejected on decode.

status.title: Readiness status
status.description: Whether the project covers a requirement. found: covered, with evidence a deterministic verifier confirmed. partial: some of it is covered. missing: nothing was found. unverified: something may be there but the evidence did not confirm, or it could not be determined; it never counts as covered. contradicted: two pieces of evidence disagree. not_applicable: only on a checklist or status-view item, never on a finding: nothing was found for a requirement of one control-surface transport (mcp, openapi, native_adapter) while a requirement of another transport is found, so the project uses that one instead; it never counts as covered or as missing. A value outside this list is rejected on decode.

source.title: Finding source
source.description: Who produced a finding. deterministic: a rule found it. model_verified: a model proposed it and the deterministic verifier re-read and confirmed its evidence. model_unverified: a model proposed it and the evidence did not confirm; it never counts as covered. A value outside this list is rejected on decode.

level.title: Requirement level
level.description: mandatory: the audit check this feeds cannot pass without it. recommended: the audit reports a warning without it.

satisfiedBy.title: How a requirement can be satisfied
satisfiedBy.description: The finding sources that can cover a requirement. deterministic: a rule finds it. model_verified: a model finding whose evidence the verifier confirmed. model_unverified is never a way to satisfy a requirement and is not in this list.

schemaVersion.title: Readiness schema version
schemaVersion.description: Exactly 1 in this release; any other value is rejected on decode, so a document from a different contract generation fails closed.

requirementId.title: Requirement ID
requirementId.description: The stable ID of a catalog requirement: dotted lower-case segments starting with req, for example req.package.manifest. At most 64 characters. Renaming one is an API change.

checkId.title: Audit check ID
checkId.description: The ID of the integration audit check a requirement or finding feeds, for example package.authenticity. Dotted lower-case identifier, at most 64 characters, the grammar of internal/integrationaudit.

findingId.title: Finding ID
findingId.description: The stable ID of a finding: fnd_ and 16 lower-case hexadecimal characters, derived from the requirement and the evidence so the same finding keeps its ID across scans.

sha256.title: SHA-256 digest
sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest as 64 lower-case hexadecimal characters.

relativePath.title: Path relative to the scanned root
relativePath.description: A slash-separated path below the directory the operator named: 1 to 512 characters, never absolute, no drive letter, no backslash, no control character and no empty, . or .. segment.

text.title: Short text
text.description: A human-readable sentence or two: 1 to 1000 characters.

localizedText.title: English and Italian text
localizedText.description: The same text in English and in Italian. Both are mandatory in the catalog.

remediationText.title: Remediation text
remediationText.description: What to do to cover the requirement. English is always present; Italian is present when the text comes from the catalog and may be absent on a model-proposed remediation, in which case the report shows the catalog Italian instead.

summary.title: Status counts
summary.description: How many requirements are in each status. The counts add up to the number of requirements in the checklist; not_applicable is absent when it would be zero.

not_applicable.description: Requirements of a control-surface transport the project does not use, because a requirement of another transport is found. Absent when zero.
